definition: Relating to ordinary citizens rather than the military or religion
example_sentence: The country was torn apart by civil war.

definition: To give an honor or right, or to discuss something with others
example_sentence: The university conferred an honorary degree on the author.

definition: Relating to a group of people with a shared culture, language or origin
example_sentence: The city is home to many ethnic groups.

definition: To fill a space or time, or to take control of a place
example_sentence: Parks occupy a third of the city's area.

definition: A government, especially one that is not freely elected
example_sentence: The regime banned all opposition parties.

definition: To agree to do something, or to start a task
example_sentence: Few companies undertake research that lasts more than five years.

definition: To make changes to a law or document
example_sentence: Parliament amended the law to protect workers.

definition: A part of a legal document, or a part of a sentence with a verb
example_sentence: A clause in the contract allows either side to cancel it.

definition: A serious disagreement or fight
example_sentence: The conflict between the two groups lasted for years.

definition: To ask for advice or information from someone or something
example_sentence: Patients should consult a doctor before taking the drug.

definition: An early version of a document, not yet final
example_sentence: The first draft of the report was too long.

definition: To make sure that a law or rule is obeyed
example_sentence: Police are enforcing the new speed limits.

definition: Coming from or relating to the outside
example_sentence: The company hired external experts to review its accounts.

definition: Respecting different opinions and individual freedom
example_sentence: The city is known for its liberal attitudes.

definition: An official document that gives permission to do or own something
example_sentence: You need a license to drive a car.

definition: Relating to the mind
example_sentence: Exercise benefits both physical and mental health.

definition: To aim something at a particular group or purpose, or to find your position
example_sentence: The course is oriented toward practical skills.

definition: To try to achieve something over a long time, or to follow
example_sentence: Many graduates pursue careers in research.

definition: The income that a government or company receives
example_sentence: Tourism is the main source of revenue for the island.

definition: Something or someone used instead of another
example_sentence: Honey can be used as a substitute for sugar.

definition: The movement of people or goods from one place to another
example_sentence: Public transit is cheap and reliable in the city.

definition: Health, happiness and safety, or government help for people in need
example_sentence: The law protects the welfare of children.

definition: To fasten or join one thing to another
example_sentence: Please attach a copy of your diploma to the form.

definition: Having the ability or skill to do something
example_sentence: The new robot is capable of lifting heavy loads.

definition: To work together with others for a shared purpose
example_sentence: The two countries agreed to cooperate on research.

definition: To show something so that people can see it, or to show a feeling
example_sentence: The museum displays tools from the Stone Age.

definition: The state of being male or female, especially in social terms
example_sentence: The study found no gender differences in test scores.

definition: Information, ideas or effort put into something
example_sentence: The final plan included input from local residents.

definition: To tell someone what to do, or to teach

definition: The period of time or space between two events or things
example_sentence: The bus comes at regular intervals.

definition: To make something known that was secret or hidden
example_sentence: The documents revealed serious problems in the company.

definition: To become healthy again, or to return to a normal state
example_sentence: The economy slowly recovered after the war.

definition: A very small amount or sign that something existed
example_sentence: Scientists found traces of water on the planet.

definition: How often something happens, especially a disease
example_sentence: The incidence of heart disease is falling.

definition: Money that a government pays to reduce the cost of something
example_sentence: Farmers receive subsidies to grow certain crops.

definition: To be the real cause or basis of something

definition: A way of communicating or sending something, or a passage for water

definition: To consist of or be made up of parts
example_sentence: The committee comprises ten members.

definition: A period of ten years
example_sentence: The population doubled over the last decade.

definition: To say that something is not true, or to refuse to give something
example_sentence: Both sides deny any responsibility for the attack.

definition: To get rid of something (usually used with of)
example_sentence: Hospitals must dispose of waste safely.

definition: To provide someone or something with what is needed
example_sentence: The new lab is equipped with modern machines.

definition: To remove or take out something, often with effort
example_sentence: Oil is extracted from deep under the sea.

definition: The base or principle on which something is built, or an organization that gives money
example_sentence: Trust is the foundation of any relationship.

definition: To promise that something will happen or is true
example_sentence: A degree does not guarantee a good job.

definition: To put something into something else

definition: To become involved in a situation to change or stop it

definition: A particular way of doing something

definition: To repeat the exact words that someone else said or wrote
example_sentence: The article quotes several experts.

definition: To change something to its opposite, or to cancel a decision
example_sentence: The court reversed the earlier decision.

definition: Being the only one

definition: To some degree; slightly
example_sentence: The results were somewhat disappointing.

definition: To give a document for approval, or to accept someone's control
example_sentence: Students must submit their papers by Friday.

definition: To pass something from one person or place to another
example_sentence: Mosquitoes transmit the disease to humans.

definition: A close connection between people, or a form of loan to a government or company
example_sentence: The study examined the bond between mothers and infants.

definition: A number that shows the level of something, or an alphabetical list in a book
example_sentence: The price index rose by two percent.

definition: The ability to learn and understand, or secret information about enemies
example_sentence: Intelligence is only partly determined by genes.

definition: In or to a foreign country, especially across the sea
example_sentence: Many students choose to study overseas.
